message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && find . -maxdepth 4 -path '*out*' -o -name 'bpf-object-fuzzer' -type f -ls | head -20 && file minimal.bpf.o && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
p='minimal.bpf.o'
data=bytearray(open(p,'rb').read())
# parse ELF64 section header table offset and entsize
print(len(data))
e_shoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,0x28)[0]
e_shentsize=struct.unpack_from('<H',data,0x3a)[0]
e_shnum=struct.unpack_from('<H',data,0x3c)[0]
print(hex(e_shoff), e_shentsize, e_shnum)
for i in range(e_shnum):
 off=e_shoff+i*e_shentsize
 sh_type=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,off+4)[0]
 sh_offset=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,off+0x18)[0]
 sh_size=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,off+0x20)[0]
 sh_link=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,off+0x28)[0]
 sh_info=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,off+0x2c)[0]
 sh_entsize=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,off+0x38)[0]
 print(i, sh_type, hex(sh_offset), hex(sh_size), sh_link, sh_info, hex(sh_entsize), 'entsize_off', hex(off+0x38), 'info_off', hex(off+0x2c))
PY` executed with exit code 0.
